verdict.rationale: x402 Bazaar is a published public catalog of payment-gated services. Agents can query it without an API key, through REST/OpenAPI search with intent and price filters or through the Bazaar MCP server as tool calls. A runtime probe confirmed the keyless discovery endpoint is live and returns real payable listings.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my agent can discover payable services and APIs through a published directory or discovery index

citations.quote: The x402 Bazaar is a catalog of payment-gated services discovered by the CDP Facilitator.
Bazaar discovery is public. You do not need a CDP API key to use the discovery APIs or the corresponding TypeScript SDK functions.
Let an MCP-compatible agent discover services with tool calls.
The x402 Bazaar lists more than 23,000 x402 resources.

a plain GET to https://api.cdp.coinbase.com/platform/v2/x402/discovery/resources returned real payable-service listings (USDC amounts, asset contracts, network eip155:8453/Base, scheme exact, maxTimeoutSeconds) with no CDP API key, exactly as the docs state.
